description: Fetch a researcher's public profile from ORCID: name, other names, biography, keywords, researcher URLs, external identifiers such as Scopus Author ID, ResearcherID, and Loop profile, public email addresses with their verified flags, and countries. This is the entry point for building a researcher dossier. Pass a bare ORCID iD (0000-0001-2345-6789) or a full URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). Set include_history for the record's trust signals: when and how it was created, whether the researcher claimed it, and whether it has a verified email, private addresses included. The profile contains only publicly visible data — researchers control visibility per field.

include_history.description: Also return the record's history. Reads ORCID's full record instead of the person section; for a researcher with many works that upstream response can exceed 10 MB, and the first call for such a record can time out while ORCID builds it, so call again after a timeout. This tool still returns only the profile and its history. Set it only when the trust signals are needed.

orcid_id.description: ORCID iD — bare (0000-0001-2345-6789) or as an orcid.org URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789). The check digit may be X or x.

name: orcid_get_profile

countries.description: Countries listed in the researcher's address section.

primary.description: True when this is the primary email address.

verified.description: Whether ORCID marks the address verified, exactly as published; absent when ORCID omits it. ORCID shows only verified addresses publicly, so this reads true in practice — history.verifiedEmail is the signal that covers private addresses.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `profile_not_found`: The ORCID iD does not correspond to a registered researcher. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

externalIdentifiers.description: External identifiers from scholarly systems (Scopus, Web of Science, Loop, etc.).

items.description: External identifier linking to another scholarly system.

type.description: Identifier type (e.g. Scopus Author ID, ResearcherID, Loop).

url.description: Resolver URL for this identifier, if provided.

history.description: The record's history, present only with include_history. Each field is present only when ORCID published it.

claimed.description: Whether the researcher has claimed the record. A record a member organization creates through the API stays unclaimed until the researcher takes control of it.

createdDate.description: When the ORCID record was created (its submission date), ISO 8601 UTC.

creationMethod.description: How the record was created, as ORCID publishes it: API (by a member organization), DIRECT, MEMBER_REFERRED, or WEBSITE.

lastModifiedDate.description: When the record was last modified, ISO 8601 UTC.

verifiedEmail.description: Whether the record has at least one verified email address, private addresses included.

verifiedPrimaryEmail.description: Whether the record's primary email address is verified, public or not.

keywords.description: Research keywords set by the researcher.

notice.description: Names the profile sections with no public data — ORCID visibility is set per field, so an empty section may be private — and, for a deprecated iD, the primary iD it was merged into.

orcidId.description: Normalized ORCID iD (bare format without URI prefix).

otherNames.description: Other names listed on the ORCID record.

researcherUrls.description: Researcher-provided URLs (personal site, lab page, blog, etc.).

title: Get ORCID Researcher Profile
